text.arabic_uthmani: أَلَمْ تَرَ أَنَّ ٱللَّهَ يُولِجُ ٱلَّيْلَ فِى ٱلنَّهَارِ وَيُولِجُ ٱلنَّهَارَ فِى ٱلَّيْلِ وَسَخَّرَ ٱلشَّمْسَ وَٱلْقَمَرَ كُلٌّۭ يَجْرِىٓ إِلَىٰٓ أَجَلٍۢ مُّسَمًّۭى وَأَنَّ ٱللَّهَ بِمَا تَعْمَلُونَ خَبِيرٌۭ

words.gloss_range: jussive negating particle that turns the opening perception verb into a challenge of recognition

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: apocopated perception verb in the opening challenge

words.prose: {{ar:لَمْ}} ({{tr:lam}}) binds directly to {{ar:تَرَ}} ({{tr:tara}}), so the ayah opens as a negated-recognition challenge rather than a flat report. The particle makes the addressee account for why the visible cosmic order has not already been seen as evidence. Its force also reaches forward: the seeing verb governs both asserted content clauses, so cosmic governance and moral knowledge belong to one perception demand.

topics.headline: negated recognition challenge
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears the opening as a challenge to recognize what should already be evident.
topics.reason: The QAC grammar identifies {{ar:لَمْ}} ({{tr:lam}}) as jussive negation before the apocopated seeing verb, matching the CRITICAL challenge rows.

topics.headline: dual content governance
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees that the question governs the cosmic signs and the final knowledge clause together.
topics.reason: Attachment evidence links the opening perception verb to the first {{ar:أَنَّ}} ({{tr:anna}}) clause and to the second coordinated {{ar:أَنَّ}} ({{tr:anna}}) clause.

words.gloss_range: apocopated second-person perception verb spanning seeing, recognition, and judgment
words.root_gloss_range: root field covers visual seeing, opinion, judgment, and dream perception; locally the challenge selects recognition through observable signs

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: jussive negating particle before the perception verb

words.prose: {{ar:تَرَ}} ({{tr:tara}}) is shortened under {{ar:لَمْ}} ({{tr:lam}}), giving the addressed verb a clipped challenge-form. The root does not reduce seeing to eyesight alone: it carries recognition and judgment, so the addressee is being asked to perceive cosmic order as meaningful evidence. The formulaic opening places the audience inside a recurring Quranic evidentiary scene (22:18, 35:27, 57:17), with a same-surah shift from communal seeing in 31:20 to this singular address; the discourse also shifts divine knowledge into something human perception is pressed to acknowledge.

topics.headline: apocopated addressed seeing
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the seeing verb is directly addressed and grammatically tightened by the negation.
topics.reason: QAC marks an imperfect second masculine singular apocopated after {{ar:لَمْ}} ({{tr:lam}}).

topics.headline: seeing as judgment
topics.reader_payoff: The reader understands the requested seeing as recognition and judgment, not only visual detection.
topics.reason: The root range includes sight, opinion, and dream; local syntax selects evidentiary recognition rather than every possible perception branch.

topics.headline: evidentiary formula
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears the opening as part of a recurring cosmic-evidence formula (22:18, 35:27, 57:17).
topics.reason: The CRITICAL rows supply concrete formula parallels, and nothing in the local grammar blocks using them as resonance.

topics.headline: perception handoff
topics.reader_payoff: The reader tracks a shift from divine cosmic capacity into addressed human recognition.
topics.reason: Boundary rows describe the move from divine sight and abstract capacity into an addressed perception challenge.

words.gloss_range: annulative/assertive particle opening the first seen content clause

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: apocopated perception verb in the opening challenge

words.prose: {{ar:أَنَّ}} ({{tr:anna}}) converts what follows into asserted content under {{ar:تَرَ}} ({{tr:tara}}). The cosmic sequence is therefore not scenery after the question; it is the proposition the addressee is challenged to recognize as true.

topics.headline: first asserted content
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the cosmic signs are framed as asserted content to be recognized.
topics.reason: QAC and attachment evidence identify the particle as governing the first content complement of the perception verb.

words.gloss_range: divine proper name in accusative as subject of the first asserted content clause
words.root_gloss_range: divine-name field with worship-directed sovereignty and refuge pressure; locally the proper name supplies the agent of the cosmic acts
words.prose: {{ar:ٱللَّهَ}} ({{tr:allaha}}) stands as the accusative subject inside the first {{ar:أَنَّ}} ({{tr:anna}}) clause. The proper name fixes the agent before the alternating night-day insertion and the subjugation of sun and moon unfold, so the cosmic mechanics are not autonomous processes. The same name later returns at word 26, shifting from cosmic actor to knower of deeds and tying the ayah's visible order to accountability; that reprise also gathers the same-surah divine-sovereignty thread around 31:20, 31:23, and the {{ar:خَبِيرٌ}} ({{tr:khabirun}}) closure of 31:16.

topics.headline: accusative divine agent
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the cosmic sequence anchored to a named subject before the actions begin.
topics.reason: QAC marks the proper noun as accusative, and attachment evidence makes it the governed subject of {{ar:أَنَّ}} ({{tr:anna}}).

topics.headline: proper name sovereignty
topics.reader_payoff: The reader senses worship-directed sovereignty behind the named cosmic agent without turning the proper name into a full etymological gloss.
topics.reason: The divine-name root pressure is relevant but locally narrowed to the proper-name referent acting in the clause.

topics.headline: cosmic to moral reprise
topics.reader_payoff: The reader follows the repeated divine name from cosmic agency to moral knowledge in the same ayah.
topics.reason: The same divine name heads both content clauses, with word 4 governing cosmic actions and word 26 governing the knowledge predicate.

topics.headline: same-surah theological spine
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears this naming as part of the same-surah divine-attribute sequence (31:16, 31:20).
topics.reason: The CRITICAL rows give concrete same-surah links, which function as local resonance rather than replacing the grammar.

words.gloss_range: Form IV imperfect causative: making one phase enter another
words.root_gloss_range: root image centers on entering or penetrating inward; locally Form IV makes God cause night to enter daylight
words.prose: {{ar:يُولِجُ}} ({{tr:yuliju}}) pictures more than adjacency between night and day: Form IV makes the action causative, and the root image is entry into an interior. The imperfect form keeps the process ongoing. Because the same verb returns in word 10 with the objects reversed, the reader sees controlled reciprocal transition rather than a one-sided change.

topics.headline: ongoing causative entry
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that God is causing one time-phase to enter another as an ongoing process.
topics.reason: QAC identifies an imperfect Form IV verb, supporting both ongoing aspect and causative force.

topics.headline: deep interior root image
topics.reader_payoff: The reader imagines transition as interior entry, not mere overlap, while staying within the local night-day frame.
topics.reason: The root image supports inward entry, but local objects limit it to temporal/cosmic interpenetration.

topics.headline: rare repeated transition
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the first verb preparing a mirrored transition when the same rare verb returns.
topics.reason: The repetition and reversed object-preposition frame are locally visible and supported by the coordinated second clause.

words.gloss_range: definite accusative night as the inserted object
words.root_gloss_range: night field with darkness, concealment, and phase-wholeness; locally the whole night phase is moved into daylight
words.prose: {{ar:ٱلَّيْلَ}} ({{tr:al-layla}}) is the first object of {{ar:يُولِجُ}} ({{tr:yuliju}}): night is the phase being made to enter. Its definiteness presents night as a whole known domain, while the root-field pressure of darkness and concealment gives the motion a tangible quality. When night returns as the destination in word 13, the ayah turns object and container into a reciprocal pattern.

topics.headline: night as inserted object
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that night is not only mentioned; it is the acted-upon phase entering daylight.
topics.reason: QAC marks the word as a definite accusative direct object of the first insertion verb.

topics.headline: darkness concealment phase
topics.reader_payoff: The reader feels the night phase as a dark, concealing domain while the grammar keeps it a noun object.
topics.reason: The semantic field is meaningful, but the local use is the concrete cosmic phase rather than an abstract theology of darkness.

topics.headline: night-day pair reversal
topics.reader_payoff: The reader tracks night from object to later receiving domain inside the mirrored pair.
topics.reason: The row family links {{ar:ٱلَّيْلَ}} ({{tr:al-layla}}) to the dominant night-day pair and to its reversed syntactic role in word 13.

words.gloss_range: preposition marking the receiving domain after the entry verb
words.prose: {{ar:فِى}} ({{tr:fi}}) completes the first insertion unit by making daylight the receiving domain. With {{ar:يُولِجُ}} ({{tr:yuliju}}), it leans from simple location toward motion into containment, so the verse depicts night entering daylight rather than merely being beside it.

topics.headline: into-container complement
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the preposition turn the verb into a complete entry-into-domain image.
topics.reason: The preposition follows the entry verb and governs the genitive destination, supporting the CRITICAL containment and transition rows.

words.gloss_range: definite genitive daylight as the receiving domain of the first insertion
words.root_gloss_range: root field spans daylight and river/flow imagery; locally daylight is the destination phase
words.prose: {{ar:ٱلنَّهَارِ}} ({{tr:an-nahari}}) is governed by {{ar:فِى}} ({{tr:fi}}), making daylight the container-like destination for night. The daylight term is definite and whole, while the broader {{ar:ن ه ر}} ({{tr:n-h-r}}) field of daylight and flowing river can sharpen the sense of a bright, moving domain without displacing the local day meaning. When the word returns as accusative in word 11, daylight changes from receiver to moved object.

topics.headline: daylight as destination
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices daylight functioning as the receiving domain in the first half of the mirror.
topics.reason: QAC marks the noun as genitive after the preposition, and attachment evidence places it inside the first insertion phrase.

topics.headline: day-river root pressure
topics.reader_payoff: The reader senses the daylight term's flow-field while the local sense remains daylight, not river.
topics.reason: The root has daylight and river domains; QAC and local collocation select daylight, so river imagery can only color the word.

topics.headline: destination to object reversal
topics.reader_payoff: The reader tracks daylight as it later reverses from container to inserted object.
topics.reason: The same daylight word reappears in the reverse insertion frame with accusative case.

words.gloss_range: conjunction coordinating the reverse insertion clause
words.prose: {{ar:وَ}} ({{tr:wa}}) does real structural work: it coordinates the second {{ar:يُولِجُ}} ({{tr:yuliju}}) clause with the first, so the reverse movement is coasserted rather than secondary. The result is two balanced verbal clauses that display reciprocity in the night-day cycle.

topics.headline: balanced reverse coordination
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the reverse insertion as an equal half of the cosmic pattern.
topics.reason: Attachment evidence identifies the second insertion clause as coordinated with the first.

words.gloss_range: repeated Form IV imperfect causative in the reversed night-day frame
words.root_gloss_range: entry/penetration root image; locally repeated causative entry with daylight as object and night as destination
words.prose: The second {{ar:يُولِجُ}} ({{tr:yuliju}}) repeats the same imperfect Form IV shape, but the objects reverse. That exact repetition lets the ayah show ongoing causative control from both sides of the cycle: daylight enters night just as night entered daylight. The repeated rare verb makes the symmetry audible and grammatical, not just conceptual.

topics.headline: repeated ongoing causative
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the reverse movement has the same ongoing causative force as the first.
topics.reason: The second verb matches the first as an imperfect Form IV verb in a coordinated clause.

topics.headline: mirrored night-day formula
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the night-day pair arranged as a mirrored formula rather than two loose statements.
topics.reason: The CRITICAL rows and local syntax both support exact verbal repetition with reversed object-preposition roles.

words.gloss_range: definite accusative daylight as the inserted object in the reverse clause
words.root_gloss_range: daylight field with possible flow associations; locally the whole daylight phase is acted on
words.prose: {{ar:ٱلنَّهَارَ}} ({{tr:an-nahara}}) now becomes the accusative object: daylight is the phase being moved into night. This reverses word 8, where daylight was the receiving domain. The effect is a four-part chiasm in which night and day exchange object and container roles.

topics.headline: daylight as moved object
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices daylight itself being acted upon, not only serving as the setting for night.
topics.reason: QAC marks {{ar:ٱلنَّهَارَ}} ({{tr:an-nahara}}) as a definite accusative direct object of the second insertion verb.

topics.headline: chiastic day role shift
topics.reader_payoff: The reader tracks daylight shifting from destination to object inside the mirrored four-term pattern.
topics.reason: The local pattern reverses the earlier day role and pairs it with the matching reversal of night.

words.gloss_range: second preposition marking the reciprocal receiving domain
words.prose: The second {{ar:فِى}} ({{tr:fi}}) repeats the same prepositional frame and sends daylight into night. Its repetition gives the mirror stable grammar: object plus entry-preposition plus destination appears in both halves of the cycle.

topics.headline: reciprocal prepositional frame
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the second half use the same into-domain grammar as the first.
topics.reason: The preposition governs the genitive night destination and repeats the frame of word 7.

words.gloss_range: definite genitive night as the receiving domain in the reverse clause
words.root_gloss_range: night field with darkness and concealment; locally the whole night phase receives daylight
words.prose: {{ar:ٱلَّيْلِ}} ({{tr:al-layli}}) completes the reversal as the genitive destination after {{ar:فِى}} ({{tr:fi}}). Night is now the receiving domain, whereas in word 6 it was the inserted object. The repeated definite term lets the ayah enact cyclical reciprocity with the same two phases, and the morphologically live {{ar:ل ي ل}} ({{tr:l-y-l}}) root dispute remains subordinate to that local night-role.

topics.headline: night as receiving domain
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices night becoming the container-like destination in the second half.
topics.reason: QAC marks the noun as genitive after the preposition in the reverse insertion unit.

topics.headline: root dispute limited
topics.reader_payoff: The reader knows there is lexical pressure around the night-root field, while the local grammar keeps night as the selected sense.
topics.reason: The root question is morphologically live but does not change the local night-domain reading.

topics.headline: cyclical reciprocity
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees night shift from object to container in a full night-day/day-night chiasm.
topics.reason: The row family is directly supported by the repeated terms and reversed syntactic roles.

words.gloss_range: conjunction pivoting from alternating phases to celestial subjugation
words.prose: {{ar:وَ}} ({{tr:wa}}) extends the seen content from the night-day insertion cycle to a new divine act: subjugating the sun and moon. The conjunction keeps the next clause inside the same evidentiary chain while shifting the scene from process to control.

topics.headline: cycle to subjugation pivot
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the ayah moving from reciprocal transition to explicit celestial control without leaving the proof-chain.
topics.reason: Attachment evidence identifies the following verb clause as another coordinated divine act under the first content clause.

words.gloss_range: Form II perfect: subjected, compelled into service
words.root_gloss_range: root family includes subjugation/service and mockery; locally Form II selects compelled service under divine agency

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: repeated divine name heading the content clauses

words.prose: {{ar:سَخَّرَ}} ({{tr:sakhkhara}}) changes the verbal texture: after the ongoing imperfects, a perfect Form II verb states that the sun and moon have been decisively subjected. The root family can include mockery, but here the local objects and Quranic collocation select compelled service and governance. The implicit subject remains the same {{ar:ٱللَّهَ}} ({{tr:allaha}}), so the celestial bodies run toward an appointed term because they have already been placed under command.

topics.headline: perfect after imperfects
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears a shift from ongoing alternation to a completed act of subjugation.
topics.reason: QAC marks a perfect verb after two imperfect insertion verbs, and attachment places it as a coordinated divine act.

topics.headline: implicit divine subject
topics.reader_payoff: The reader keeps God as the subject even though the verb itself does not repeat the name.
topics.reason: The coordinated clause inherits the divine subject from the first {{ar:أَنَّ}} ({{tr:anna}}) content.

topics.headline: compelled service root
topics.reader_payoff: The reader feels subjugation as compelled service, while the mockery branch is excluded by the local sun-moon objects.
topics.reason: The root family contains multiple branches, but Form II with celestial objects and QAC grammar license the subjected-service sense.

topics.headline: sun-moon term cluster
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees subjugation moving naturally into the sun-moon appointed-term formula.
topics.reason: The collocation evidence links this verb with the following luminaries and appointed term.

words.gloss_range: definite accusative sun as the first object of subjugation
words.root_gloss_range: sun field includes heat, brilliance, and force; locally the known sun is the first subjected luminary
words.prose: {{ar:ٱلشَّمْسَ}} ({{tr:ash-shamsa}}) receives the action of {{ar:سَخَّرَ}} ({{tr:sakhkhara}}) as the first definite object. The sun's heat and brilliance make the subjugation more vivid: even the blazing luminary is placed in service. Its pairing with {{ar:ٱلْقَمَرَ}} ({{tr:al-qamara}}) forms the dyad that {{ar:كُلٌّ}} ({{tr:kullun}}) will then distribute into individual running toward an endpoint.

topics.headline: sun as subjugated object
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the known sun as a direct object under divine subjugation.
topics.reason: QAC marks the word as definite accusative direct object of {{ar:سَخَّرَ}} ({{tr:sakhkhara}}).

topics.headline: heat brilliance under command
topics.reader_payoff: The reader feels the power of the sun's heat and brilliance being subordinated, without turning the word into a separate root allegory.
topics.reason: The root-image rows add vivid pressure, but local grammar keeps the referent the physical sun.

topics.headline: sun-moon dyad
topics.reader_payoff: The reader follows the sun into a paired luminary object that will be distributed by the next clause.
topics.reason: The following conjunction and moon create a coordinated object pair, and the contextual evidence supports the formulaic dyad.

words.gloss_range: conjunction joining the moon to the same subjugation verb
words.prose: {{ar:وَ}} ({{tr:wa}}) binds the moon to the same governing verb as the sun. The conjunction makes one shared object pair under one act of subjugation, not two unrelated celestial mentions.

topics.headline: shared object coordination
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees sun and moon held together as one governed pair.
topics.reason: Attachment evidence identifies the moon as a conjoined object under the same verb.

words.gloss_range: definite accusative moon as conjoined object of subjugation
words.root_gloss_range: moon field includes moonlight, dazzlement, and other branches; locally the known moon is paired with the sun under subjugation

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: distributed running clause for the luminaries

words.prose: {{ar:ٱلْقَمَرَ}} ({{tr:al-qamara}}) is the conjoined accusative object sharing {{ar:سَخَّرَ}} ({{tr:sakhkhara}}) with the sun. The root's dazzlement and moonlight pressures sharpen the visual contrast with the sun, while unrelated branches such as gambling stay outside the local sense. The strong sun-moon pairing makes the next phrase, {{ar:كُلٌّ يَجْرِى}} ({{tr:kullun yajri}}), read as each luminary running within a governed order.

topics.headline: moon as conjoined object
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the moon sharing the same subjugating action as the sun.
topics.reason: QAC marks {{ar:ٱلْقَمَرَ}} ({{tr:al-qamara}}) as a definite accusative conjoined object.

topics.headline: moonlight dazzlement limited
topics.reader_payoff: The reader senses the moon as bright and dazzling while unrelated root branches remain inactive.
topics.reason: The local celestial noun licenses moonlight and brightness pressure but blocks unrelated branches such as gambling.

topics.headline: sun-moon formula
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears the moon completing a familiar sun-moon collocation.
topics.reason: The contextual evidence and local coordination both support the strong sun-moon pairing.

words.gloss_range: indefinite nominative distributive subject: each one
words.root_gloss_range: totality field; locally distributive each applies within the just-named sun-moon pair
words.prose: {{ar:كُلٌّ}} ({{tr:kullun}}) opens a nominal clause after the two luminaries. Its tanwīn and singular predicate make the sense distributive: each one runs, rather than the pair being blurred into a collective. The word therefore turns the subjected dyad into individually bounded courses, while the same totality marker links cosmic scope here with moral totality in 31:18 and other same-surah uses (31:31, 31:32).

topics.headline: parenthetical nominal subject
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices a new clause stepping in to explain the state of the subjugated bodies.
topics.reason: QAC marks {{ar:كُلٌّ}} ({{tr:kullun}}) as a nominative indefinite subject of a nominal clause.

topics.headline: distributive each not merged all
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the sun and moon assigned individual motion rather than one collective motion.
topics.reason: The singular predicate with {{ar:كُلٌّ}} ({{tr:kullun}}) supports distributive each within the defined pair.

topics.headline: local totality marker
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears a same-surah totality marker linking this distribution with the ethical warning of 31:18.
topics.reason: The CRITICAL rows give a concrete same-surah comparison (31:18), which can serve as resonance without changing the local parse.

words.gloss_range: Form I imperfect intransitive motion: runs/proceeds
words.root_gloss_range: root field covers flowing water, coursing/orbiting motion, and affairs proceeding; locally each luminary runs along a bounded course
words.prose: {{ar:يَجْرِى}} ({{tr:yajri}}) gives each luminary ongoing motion. The root can describe flowing water, a course or channel, and affairs proceeding; here that range is narrowed to celestial running along a path. Form I keeps the motion intransitive under the prior subjugation: the bodies run, but the preceding verb has already explained why their motion is governed. The same running language also prepares the nearby ship-running echo in 31:31.

topics.headline: ongoing luminary motion
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the sun and moon as continually running within the order just described.
topics.reason: QAC marks an imperfect third masculine singular predicate attached distributively to {{ar:كُلٌّ}} ({{tr:kullun}}).

topics.headline: course channel root image
topics.reader_payoff: The reader senses a path or channel behind the running, while the local scene remains celestial motion rather than literal river flow.
topics.reason: The root field includes water and proceeding affairs, but the local subject is each subjugated luminary.

topics.headline: intransitive under subjugation
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the bodies run intransitively after having already been subjected by God.
topics.reason: Form I motion differs from causative forms, and the preceding {{ar:سَخَّرَ}} ({{tr:sakhkhara}}) supplies the governing agency.

topics.headline: ship-running echo
topics.reader_payoff: The reader can connect celestial running here with the later ship-running sign in 31:31.
topics.reason: The CRITICAL rows provide the concrete same-surah echo (31:31), and it fits the local running vocabulary.

words.gloss_range: directional preposition marking motion toward a temporal endpoint

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: ongoing running predicate of each luminary

words.prose: {{ar:إِلَىٰ}} ({{tr:ila}}) turns the running into motion toward a limit. After the imperfect {{ar:يَجْرِى}} ({{tr:yajri}}) has opened an ongoing process, this preposition makes the process bounded by a destination in time.

topics.headline: motion toward temporal limit
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that ongoing celestial motion is not endless drift but movement toward an endpoint.
topics.reason: The preposition governs {{ar:أَجَلٍ}} ({{tr:ajalin}}), turning running into motion toward a term.

words.gloss_range: indefinite genitive term/deadline governed by {{ar:إِلَىٰ}} ({{tr:ila}})
words.root_gloss_range: root field includes fixing, delaying, and appointed term; locally it names the endpoint of each luminary's running

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: designating modifier of the appointed term

words.prose: {{ar:أَجَلٍ}} ({{tr:ajalin}}) is the endpoint toward which each body runs. The root-field of fixing and deferred limit makes the motion scheduled, not open-ended. Its indefiniteness lets the term remain unspecified to the listener, but the following {{ar:مُسَمًّى}} ({{tr:musamman}}) immediately marks it as designated; the phrase belongs to a recurring appointed-term formula (13:2, 35:13, 39:5).

topics.headline: endpoint deadline
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the cosmic running as bounded by a deadline rather than endless autonomy.
topics.reason: QAC marks the noun as genitive after {{ar:إِلَىٰ}} ({{tr:ila}}), and the root evidence supports appointed-term semantics.

topics.headline: indefinite then specified
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the term is unnamed to the audience yet immediately qualified as designated.
topics.reason: The noun is indefinite and followed by a descriptive passive participle modifier.

topics.headline: appointed-term formula
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears the phrase as part of a Quranic appointed-term formula (13:2, 35:13, 39:5).
topics.reason: The CRITICAL rows provide concrete formula references and co-occurrence support with the naming root.

words.gloss_range: passive participle adjective: named/designated
words.root_gloss_range: naming/elevation field with possible marking-pressure noted by alternative analysis; locally the participle designates the appointed term
words.prose: {{ar:مُسَمًّى}} ({{tr:musamman}}) modifies {{ar:أَجَلٍ}} ({{tr:ajalin}}), so the endpoint is not merely finite but named or designated. The passive participle hides the namer on the surface, yet the surrounding clause routes that agency back to God, the one who subjects and bounds the luminaries. The naming/elevation field and the noted marking-pressure both sharpen the sense of a singled-out term, while the fixed formula is visible across 6:2, 6:60, 13:2, 35:13, and 39:5.

topics.headline: designating modifier
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the deadline is qualified as explicitly designated, not merely eventual.
topics.reason: QAC marks a passive participle adjective modifying {{ar:أَجَلٍ}} ({{tr:ajalin}}).

topics.headline: hidden divine namer
topics.reader_payoff: The reader senses divine agency behind the named term even though the passive form does not state the namer.
topics.reason: The broader clause names God as the one subjecting the luminaries, so the elided agent is contextually recoverable.

topics.headline: naming marking pressure
topics.reader_payoff: The reader feels the endpoint as singled out and lifted from vagueness into designation, while local grammar keeps the basic modifier sense.
topics.reason: The naming and elevation field survives as designation pressure; the alternate marking analysis reinforces rather than replaces the local passive participle.

topics.headline: appointed-term distribution
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears the local phrase as a recurring appointed-term formula and as a rule distributed over each luminary.
topics.reason: The phrase recurs in appointed-term contexts (6:2, 6:60, 13:2, 35:13, 39:5), and local {{ar:كُلٌّ}} ({{tr:kullun}}) distributes it over the pair.

words.gloss_range: conjunction coordinating the second asserted content clause under the opening perception verb
words.prose: {{ar:وَ}} ({{tr:wa}}) before the second {{ar:أَنَّ}} ({{tr:anna}}) keeps the final knowledge clause inside the same perception-chain. Cosmic governance and divine expertise over deeds are coordinated facts, so the moral claim does not detach from the visible signs that came before it.

topics.headline: cosmic moral coordination
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees cosmic order and divine knowledge of deeds held as co-objects of recognition.
topics.reason: Attachment evidence makes the final {{ar:أَنَّ}} ({{tr:anna}}) clause a coordinated content complement under {{ar:تَرَ}} ({{tr:tara}}).

words.gloss_range: second annulative/assertive particle opening the divine-knowledge content clause
words.prose: The second {{ar:أَنَّ}} ({{tr:anna}}) gives the knowledge claim the same assertive frame as the cosmic clause. God being {{ar:خَبِيرٌ}} ({{tr:khabirun}}) concerning what people do is not an afterthought; it is the second proposition the opening challenge asks the reader to recognize.

topics.headline: parallel asserted knowledge
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the moral knowledge clause standing structurally equal to the cosmic governance clause.
topics.reason: The second {{ar:أَنَّ}} ({{tr:anna}}) creates a parallel content clause under the same perception verb.

words.gloss_range: divine proper name in accusative as subject of the second asserted content clause
words.root_gloss_range: divine-name field with worship-directed sovereignty; locally the name heads the knowledge predicate rather than the cosmic-action predicate
words.prose: The second {{ar:ٱللَّهَ}} ({{tr:allaha}}) repeats the accusative subject position of word 4, but the predicate domain changes. First the name headed the clause of cosmic action; now it heads the claim of being {{ar:خَبِيرٌ}} ({{tr:khabirun}}) over deeds. That repetition makes one subject frame both visible order and accountable action.

topics.headline: second accusative subject
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the divine name again heading an asserted clause, now in the knowledge domain.
topics.reason: QAC marks the repeated proper noun as accusative, governed by the second {{ar:أَنَّ}} ({{tr:anna}}).

topics.headline: role shift and inclusio
topics.reader_payoff: The reader follows the same named subject from cosmic agent to knower of human deeds.
topics.reason: The repeated divine name maps the two content clauses: cosmic governance in the first and moral awareness in the second.

words.gloss_range: preposition marking the domain concerning which the final predicate applies
words.prose: {{ar:بِ}} ({{tr:bi}}) attaches the final attribute to the deed-domain. In {{ar:بِمَا}} ({{tr:bima}}), it is not a tool by which God knows; it marks what divine expertise concerns. The phrase comes before {{ar:خَبِيرٌ}} ({{tr:khabirun}}), placing human action in view before the closing attribute lands.

topics.headline: expertise domain not instrument
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that human action is the field of divine expertise, not an instrument.
topics.reason: The preposition attaches to the final knowledge predicate and governs the relative/action phrase.

topics.headline: fronted deed domain
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the deed-domain placed before the closing predicate for emphasis and focus.
topics.reason: The prepositional phrase precedes {{ar:خَبِيرٌ}} ({{tr:khabirun}}) in the final clause.

words.gloss_range: relative or maṣdariyya particle inside the deed-domain phrase
words.prose: {{ar:مَا}} ({{tr:ma}}) keeps the object of divine expertise capacious. As a relative, it points to what people do; as maṣdariyya, it can point to their doing itself. Either way, {{ar:بِمَا}} ({{tr:bima}}) places the deed-product and the doing-process before the final predicate.

topics.headline: relative and process scope
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees both discrete deeds and the activity of doing included within divine expertise.
topics.reason: QAC marks a relative pronoun, while the CRITICAL rows preserve a valid maṣdariyya reparsing that keeps the same deed-domain.

topics.headline: compact fronted bima
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the compact preposition-particle unit fronting the deed-domain before the attribute.
topics.reason: The surface phrase combines {{ar:بِ}} ({{tr:bi}}) and {{ar:مَا}} ({{tr:ma}}), and the whole prepositional phrase precedes the predicate.

words.gloss_range: second-person plural imperfect Form I: you do/work
words.root_gloss_range: root field centers on purposeful work, agency, and attributable action; locally direct plural address targets ongoing deeds

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: third-person variant contrasted with the standard address form

words.prose: {{ar:تَعْمَلُونَ}} ({{tr:taʿmaluna}}) is where the cosmic proof turns into direct address: after third-person cosmic verbs, the clause says what you do. The {{ar:ع م ل}} ({{tr:ʿ-m-l}}) field makes the object deliberate, attributable work rather than mere occurrence. Form I keeps the focus on direct doing, and the known third-person variant {{ar:يَعْمَلُونَ}} ({{tr:yaʿmaluna}}) exposes how much rhetorical pressure the standard second-person form carries. The word also joins the recurring deed-awareness formula with {{ar:خَبِيرٌ}} ({{tr:khabirun}}).

topics.headline: direct plural address pivot
topics.reader_payoff: The reader feels the ayah turn from observed cosmic order to direct confrontation with the audience's deeds.
topics.reason: QAC marks a second-person plural imperfect, and boundary evidence tracks the shift from singular witness to plural deeds.

topics.headline: purposeful accountable work
topics.reader_payoff: The reader understands the deeds as deliberate, attributable work rather than accidental happenings.
topics.reason: The root field supports purposeful action, while local grammar selects the audience's ongoing deeds.

topics.headline: Form I direct doing
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the clause target direct deeds, not secondary ideas such as transaction or employing.
topics.reason: QAC identifies Form I, which contrasts with other family forms listed in the CRITICAL row.

topics.headline: qiraat address pressure
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the standard reading points at you, while the variant would make the deeds reported as theirs.
topics.reason: The accepted variant changes person marking, so it validly highlights the rhetorical force of the standard second-person form without replacing it.

topics.headline: deed awareness formula
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears human work and divine expertise locking into a recognizable accountability formula.
topics.reason: The co-occurrence rows link {{ar:ع م ل}} ({{tr:ʿ-m-l}}) with {{ar:خ ب ر}} ({{tr:kh-b-r}}), and the local phrase realizes that pairing.

words.gloss_range: final nominative predicate: fully aware/expert
words.root_gloss_range: root field includes report, information, testing, probing, and expertise; locally it seals the clause with penetrative knowledge of deeds
words.prose: {{ar:خَبِيرٌ}} ({{tr:khabirun}}) is the final predicate of the second {{ar:أَنَّ}} ({{tr:anna}}) clause and the last word of the ayah. Its root field is sharper than generic knowing: it carries reportable information and tested, probing expertise. Positioned after cosmic ordering and the audience's deeds, the word seals the movement from visible governance to divine scrutiny, tightening the hearing-and-seeing frame of 31:28 into investigative expertise. Its same-surah recurrence in 31:16 and 31:34, plus the guttural kh-opening and long i before tanwin, makes the final attribute land as a refrain of penetrative knowledge.

topics.headline: final asserted predicate
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that divine expertise is the final asserted content the opening challenge asks them to perceive.
topics.reason: QAC marks {{ar:خَبِيرٌ}} ({{tr:khabirun}}) as the predicate completing the second {{ar:أَنَّ}} ({{tr:anna}}) clause.

topics.headline: probing reportable knowledge
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears divine awareness as penetrative expertise into deeds, not passive or generic knowing.
topics.reason: The root range includes report and probing/testing knowledge; local syntax selects the attribute of expertise concerning human deeds.

topics.headline: cosmic to epistemic seal
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees all preceding cosmic signs converted into evidence for divine scrutiny of action.
topics.reason: The final predicate follows the cosmic clauses and deed-domain phrase, making it the seal of the ayah's argument.

topics.headline: same-surah khabir refrain
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears {{ar:خَبِيرٌ}} ({{tr:khabirun}}) as part of a same-surah thread of divine knowledge (31:16, 31:34).
topics.reason: The CRITICAL rows provide concrete same-surah recurrence and boundary movement from perception to investigative expertise.

topics.headline: heavy phonetic closure
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears the final attribute close with audible weight matching its semantic force.
topics.reason: The phonetic rows concern the local final word and do not conflict with the grammar or semantics.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The reversed pair يُولِجُ ... فِي ... وَيُولِجُ ... فِي repeats one causative construction while exchanging night and day.
baseline_models.mechanism: Each opposed temporal medium is made to enter the other. The double reversal depicts a permeable boundary and reciprocal transfer, not one side simply erasing the other.

activation_trace.role: Literal entry into another interior supplies the two-way transfer mechanism.
Night as darkness supplies one persistent medium in the reciprocal pair.
Day as opening by light supplies the counter-medium into which darkness enters and which enters darkness.

changed_reading.after: God repeatedly inserts each temporal medium into the other, making their boundary a reversible zone of transfer.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: وَسَخَّرَ ... كُلٌّ يَجْرِي إِلَى أَجَلٍ gives the sun and moon individually directed motion toward a limit.
baseline_models.mechanism: Subjection converts celestial motion from autonomous recurrence into service under direction; distributive totality gives each body a course, and the course is vectorized toward a fixed temporal boundary.

activation_trace.role: Subduing and steering something for a purpose makes the celestial motion governed service.
The sun supplies the first concrete bearer of the governed course.
The moon and its light supply the second distinct bearer rather than a fused pair.
Encompassing totality distributes the predicate to every named luminary.
Continuous running supplies the sustained motion of each course.
A prescribed temporal limit supplies the destination toward which each course runs.

changed_reading.before: The sun and moon move until a time.
changed_reading.after: Each luminary performs a separately governed course whose continuous service is oriented toward a prescribed terminus.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The verse opens with أَلَمْ تَرَ and closes with خَبِيرٌ بِمَا تَعْمَلُونَ.
baseline_models.mechanism: The rhetorical act of seeing moves from sensory evidence into reflective judgment, while the final clause reverses the gaze: human work is already known in its interior reality.

activation_trace.role: Seeing by eye or insight makes the cosmic process evidence addressed to the reader.
Reflection and considered judgment extend seeing beyond bare eyesight.
Intentional action supplies the human object of the closing scrutiny.
Knowledge of an affair's interior turns observation into reciprocal accountability.

changed_reading.before: A cosmic sign is followed by a general reminder that God knows deeds.
changed_reading.after: The reader is taught to penetrate the visible sign while being reminded that intentional deeds are themselves penetrated by expert knowledge.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: أَجَلٍ مُسَمًّى modifies the endpoint with a passive designation.
baseline_models.mechanism: The endpoint is not merely eventual; it has been named and thereby individuated in advance. Direction, duration, and designation form one schedule.

activation_trace.role: The fixed duration supplies the bounded endpoint.
Naming as designation makes the endpoint specified rather than merely possible.

changed_reading.after: Every course proceeds toward an already designated boundary with its own identity in the governing order.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The sequence joins entering, نَهَار, running, and أَجَل in one temporal mechanism.
baseline_models.mechanism: A secondary material image treats night and day as volumes admitted into one another, day as an opened river-channel, celestial motion as flow, and the endpoint as a collecting basin. This models measured time as regulated hydraulic exchange.

activation_trace.role: Entry into an interior supplies the inlet action.
A river cutting a channel with running water supplies the flow-medium image within the day root.
Flowing and running connect the temporal exchange to moving liquid.
A basin that gathers and later releases water supplies an exploratory image for the terminal collector.

changed_reading.before: Night and day alternate on a clock.
changed_reading.after: Measured time can also be pictured as two regulated flows entering one another and running toward a collecting limit.

context_deltas.mechanism: The descent and delivery of water into earth, followed by growth in paired kinds, revises the hydraulic baseline into an ecological circulation: celestial timing admits the conditions from which differentiated terrestrial life emerges.

activation_trace.role: Reciprocal entry remains the focus-side transfer operation.
The river-channel branch keeps the changed reading materially anchored in the focus day root.
Delivering something downward supplies the first movement in the ecological circuit.
Conveying water by pouring supplies the transferred material.
Growth emerging from earth supplies the transformed output of the transfer.
A counterpart joined to its pair supplies differentiated but coordinated products.

structural_cues: 31:10 orders descent, water, emergence, and paired kinds, while repeating كُلّ before 31:29's reciprocal ingress and كُلٌّ.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a downward water-to-growth sequence and the focus supplies reciprocal temporal entry; I infer that the timing exchange enables the growth circuit. A live alternative is that the two passages are parallel signs without a causal ecological arrow.

changed_reading.before: The day/night exchange is a self-contained astronomical cycle.
changed_reading.after: The exchange also regulates a circulation by which above becomes water below and water becomes paired growth.

context_deltas.mechanism: Hidden carrying, weakness layered upon weakness, separation after a measured two-year span, and eventual return activate an embodied model of time: phases enter one another through maturation before a marked separation.

activation_trace.role: Entry into another interior anchors the overlapping-phase model in the focus.
A prescribed duration anchors maturation to a bounded span.
An inward pregnancy or fruit-bearing supplies the hidden phase that contains what follows.
Repeated weakening supplies cumulative transition rather than an instantaneous switch.
A child separated from mother or nursing supplies the eventual boundary between phases.
The year-cycle supplies the explicit measure of maturation.
Becoming toward an outcome supplies the trajectory through the phases.

structural_cues: 31:14 moves from interior carrying through repeated weakness and timed weaning to return; 31:29 likewise moves through mutual ingress to a designated term.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies an embodied timed transition and the focus supplies mutual temporal entry; I use gestation and weaning as a process analogy for gradual phase conversion. The live alternative is to keep 31:29 strictly calendrical and 31:14 strictly filial.

changed_reading.before: Night and day replace one another externally.
changed_reading.after: Their mutual ingress can be read as maturation: one phase grows within another until a measured separation, while both remain directed toward return.

context_deltas.mechanism: Twice the context sequences return, being informed, and prior work. This turns the focus's expert knowledge from a static attribute into a return-and-disclosure process parallel to every celestial course running toward its term.

activation_trace.role: Continuous directed motion supplies the focus-side trajectory.
Intentional work supplies what the human trajectory carries.
Interior knowledge supplies the basis for eventual disclosure.
Returning to a prior source supplies the first explicit human endpoint.
A delivered report turns known work into disclosed information.
The repeated intentional-work branch identifies the report's content.
The second return repeats and stabilizes the endpoint pattern.
The second report confirms disclosure after return.
Repeated work again supplies the disclosed payload.

structural_cues: 31:15 and 31:23 repeat the same return-report-work order before 31:29 joins a toward-term course to expert knowledge of work.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies two human return-report sequences and one cosmic course-to-term sequence; I infer a shared accountability architecture. A live alternative is that the cosmic and human trajectories are juxtaposed evidence rather than structurally parallel processes.

changed_reading.before: God presently knows what people do.
changed_reading.after: Present expert knowledge anticipates a directed return at which carried work becomes a report, just as every governed course reaches its term.

context_deltas.mechanism: A mustard-grain weight nested in rock, sky, or earth is still brought forth and paired with subtlety and expertise. The focus's inward-entry language and خَبِيرٌ therefore extend to actions hidden at minute scale and inside resistant locations.

activation_trace.role: Interior entry supplies the focus-side capacity to cross enclosing boundaries.
Intentional action remains the object whose concealment cannot defeat knowledge.
Knowledge of inward reality supplies the focus-side epistemic claim.
A measured weight supplies minute accountable scale.
A germinating seed supplies the tiny object that can remain latent yet consequential.
Massive hard rock supplies resistant enclosure.
Fineness, minuteness, and hiddenness supply the mode by which enclosure is traversed.
The repeated expert knowledge explicitly binds tiny hidden location to the focus close.

structural_cues: 31:16 nests a minimal weight through successively large enclosures, then closes with the same خَبِير predicate used in 31:29.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies nested concealment, retrieval, subtlety, and repeated expertise; I infer that the focus's cosmic ingress images the reach of knowledge into hidden deeds. A live alternative limits ingress to temporal change and uses the repeated predicate only as thematic echo.

changed_reading.before: The closing clause means that no ordinary action escapes notice.
changed_reading.after: The closing clause also claims scale- and enclosure-crossing knowledge: even a latent act embedded like a seed in rock remains retrievable.

context_deltas.mechanism: The repeated seeing-and-subjection frame is expanded by complete blessings described as outward and inward. Visible celestial regularity becomes the exposed face of a service whose interior operation is not exhausted by sight, matching the move from تَرَ to خَبِير.

activation_trace.role: Reflective seeing anchors the move from visible evidence to inferred interior order.
Knowledge of the inside completes the focus's surface-to-interior arc.
Repeated seeing supplies the explicit formal bridge to the earlier sign.
Repeated purposeful subjection broadens the focus's two luminaries to all available service.
Completion and fullness make the service encompassing rather than fragmentary.
Beneficent condition identifies the subjected order as provision.
Emergence into visibility supplies the outer face available to observation.
The hidden interior of an affair supplies the unexposed complement known by expertise.

structural_cues: 31:20 and 31:29 share أَلَمْ تَرَ, divine agency, and سَخَّرَ; only 31:20 explicitly names the outward/inward pair.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a repeated frame plus the outward/inward distinction; I infer that 31:29's visible cycle is an outer disclosure of inward governance. A live alternative reads outward/inward only as types of blessing, without making it a hermeneutic for the later sign.

changed_reading.before: Seeing the sky is sufficient recognition of the sign.
changed_reading.after: Seeing is only the outer threshold; the reciprocal ingress discloses an inwardly governed provision that expert knowledge, not eyesight alone, comprehends.

context_deltas.mechanism: An ocean repeatedly extended yet unable to exhaust the words is followed by plural creation and resurrection compressed like one self. Against that scale, each finite celestial course is a bounded execution within inexhaustible command, not a measure of the command's capacity.

activation_trace.role: Encompassing totality distributes finitude across every celestial course.
A prescribed limit supplies local boundedness.
Vast abundant water supplies the scale of the attempted writing medium.
Connected addition supplying further material creates serial extension.
Non-exhaustion negates an endpoint for the words while sharpening the finite endpoints in focus.
Meaningful speech connecting speakers supplies the inexhaustible governing expression.
Rousing what was still supplies reactivation at maximal human scale.
Unifying many things in one direction supplies compression of multiplicity into one act.

structural_cues: 31:27 denies exhaustion, 31:28 collapses multiplicity to one self, and 31:29 immediately distributes a finite term to each course.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies inexhaustible words, one-act compression, and bounded courses; I infer a distinction between finite executions and inexhaustible governing capacity. A live alternative reads the three verses as separate demonstrations of power without this scale relation.

changed_reading.before: The appointed term mainly stresses that cosmic bodies are finite.
changed_reading.after: Their finite terms become bounded instances of an order whose expressive and re-creative capacity is explicitly not exhausted by those instances.

context_deltas.mechanism: The ship runs through the sea, is covered by an interfolding wave like overhead canopies, and reaches dry land by rescue. This activates the sea-depth branch latent in the focus's split root and revises temporal flow into navigation through alternating envelopes toward a shore-like term.

activation_trace.role: The deep and turbulent body of the sea supplies a form-distant medium latent in the focus's split root mapping.
Running and flowing anchor navigation in the focus predicate.
The fixed endpoint supplies the journey's terminal orientation.
A vessel moving circularly in water supplies the vehicle image.
The exact repeated running branch transfers the focus predicate into navigation.
Abundant wide water supplies the vessel's traversed medium.
A covering laid over something supplies engulfment by an alternating envelope.
Interfolding turbulence supplies the unstable boundary through which passage occurs.
An overhead canopy supplies the enclosing shape of the wave.
Escape by separation supplies emergence from the engulfing medium.
Dry land supplies the reached shore and material analogue of a term.

structural_cues: 31:31 repeats تَرَ and تَجْرِي after 31:29; 31:32 then sequences covering wave, rescue, and arrival on land.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies repeated running plus a complete sea-passage sequence; I infer that the focus can be spatially rehearsed as navigation through alternating media toward shore. A live alternative treats the shared جري only as separate examples of subjection.

changed_reading.before: The luminaries run abstractly along celestial tracks.
changed_reading.after: Their courses can also be imagined as navigation: they traverse mutually covering temporal seas and remain oriented toward a shore-like appointed term.

context_deltas.mechanism: A bounded day is one on which parent and child cannot stand in for one another; a true promise is opposed to deceptive worldly life. This activates كُلٌّ as more than celestial distribution: each course toward term rehearses an individually nontransferable horizon.

activation_trace.role: Totality distributed over each member anchors individualized courses in the focus.
A prescribed time supplies the individual horizon.
A bounded duration supplies the accountability horizon.
One thing standing in for another supplies the substitution explicitly negated by the verse.
The parent-child relation supplies the strongest available bond that still cannot transfer the burden.
A promise fixed by time or place makes the horizon assured.
Deception by what shines but does not endure supplies the force that obscures the horizon.
Life as benefit supplies what can be misread as self-sufficient permanence.

structural_cues: 31:33 uses paired negations across parent and child, then contrasts a true promise with repeated deception immediately after 31:29's كُلٌّ and appointed term.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies non-substitution at a promised day and the focus supplies a distributed course for each luminary; I infer an analogy to individual human accountability. A live alternative confines كُلٌّ grammatically to the sun and moon without extending its distributive force to persons.

changed_reading.before: Each celestial body has its own physical schedule.
changed_reading.after: Each separate schedule rehearses a moral fact: every self approaches a promised horizon that even the nearest relation cannot traverse in its place.

context_deltas.mechanism: The final context contrasts divine knowledge with the self's ignorance of tomorrow's earning and its land of death, then repeats خَبِير. The observable daily cycle therefore becomes evidence for a designated personal horizon whose existence is visible by analogy but whose coordinates remain concealed.

activation_trace.role: Visible perception anchors the known recurring cycle.
A prescribed term anchors the concealed personal endpoint in the focus.
Expert knowledge of inward affairs supplies the knowing side of the asymmetry.
Human knowing, twice negated in the construction, supplies the limited side of the asymmetry.
Seeking and obtaining benefit supplies tomorrow's unknown human activity.
The following day supplies the nearest future that still escapes self-knowledge.
Loss of life supplies the personal terminus whose location is unknown.
The repeated expert predicate seals the contrast between designated reality and undisclosed coordinates.

structural_cues: 31:34 heads its list with the Hour, but the supplied س و ع inventory lacks a matching Hour branch, so that lexeme is used only as a structural heading; the verse then repeats وَمَا تَدْرِي نَفْسٌ and ends خَبِيرٌ.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies an observable cycle, an appointed term, explicit human ignorance of tomorrow and death-place, and repeated expertise; I infer that cosmic visibility teaches certainty without disclosure of personal coordinates. A live alternative keeps the term solely astronomical and lets 31:34 introduce personal uncertainty independently.

changed_reading.before: The visible cycle proves that celestial bodies have known endpoints.
changed_reading.after: The visible cycle trains recognition of a personal endpoint that is designated and fully known, even while tomorrow's deed and the place of death remain hidden from the traveler.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it uses the non-dominant س م م target behind مُسَمًّى and spatializes a temporal phrase. It remains anchored in word 20, the repeated ingress construction, and the running-to syntax. Downstream prose should present it only as a form-distant passage image, never as the lexical translation of أَجَلٍ مُسَمًّى.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The course runs toward مُسَمًّى after two acts of entry into interiors.

activation_trace.role: A narrow aperture through which something enters supplies the constricted-passage image latent in the split root mapping.
An entry place, gorge, or sheltering recess supplies the approach to that passage.
Continuous running supplies motion through rather than mere arrival at the constriction.
The temporal limit keeps the spatial image attached to an endpoint.

changed_reading.before: The appointed term is only a date at which motion ends.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, it can appear as a designated narrow passage through which every running course must finally move.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This cross-domain reading is surprising because it activates the coerced-labor branch of سخر and the hand-worker branch of عمل. Both are directly focus-anchored, and 31:20 repeats subjection as beneficent service. Downstream prose should qualify it as a social-economic analogy and must not imply divine exploitation or replace the primary purposeful-subjection sense.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: وَسَخَّرَ the sun and moon is followed in the same sentence by what humans تَعْمَلُونَ.

activation_trace.role: A worker compelled without wage supplies the provocative labor relation.
People working with their hands supply the human labor counterpart.
Knowledge of work's interior supplies audit of the human side of the relation.
Purposeful subjection repeated for human benefit contains the harsher labor image within service and provision.
Blessed good condition identifies the cosmic service's beneficiary frame.

changed_reading.before: The sun and moon are neutral instruments while human deeds are a separate topic.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, the cosmos appears as a tireless service workforce, making the expert audit of beneficiary human labor ethically pointed.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it moves from temporal ingress to social interiority through the وليجة branch. It remains anchored in the doubled يُولِجُ and gains context support from inward associates, followed loyalties, and betrayal. Downstream prose should call it an analogy of adoption and loyalty, not substitute social actors for night and day.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The same root that performs reciprocal insertion also carries an image of an outsider admitted as an intimate reliance.

activation_trace.role: An outsider admitted into a group's inner circle supplies the social-entry mechanism.
Knowledge of inward reality anchors the question of what has entered and become operative.
A person's intimate inner associates supply the social interior into which influence enters.
Loyal succession supplies the mechanism by which an admitted pattern persists.
Betrayal and failure of fidelity supply the reversal that reveals unstable inward loyalty.

changed_reading.before: Mutual ingress describes only changing quantities of darkness and light.
changed_reading.after: As a contained social analogy, ingress can also model how an external pattern becomes an inner allegiance whose later work reveals fidelity or betrayal.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This reading is surprising because it preserves the non-dominant و س م target behind مُسَمًّى rather than collapsing the split mapping to naming. It is anchored in word 20, the term at word 19, and the command to see. Downstream prose may say the limit is activated as marked or legible, but should retain 'named' as the primary grammatical reading.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The named term stands inside a verse framed by seeing and visible celestial courses.

activation_trace.role: A visible identifying mark supplies legibility to the designated endpoint.
Seeing by eye or insight supplies the observer capable of reading the mark.
The prescribed duration supplies what the mark identifies.

changed_reading.before: The endpoint is verbally specified but otherwise opaque.
changed_reading.after: Alongside being named, the endpoint can be carried as a marked boundary whose signs are already legible in the governed course.

strongest_changes: The visible cycle became a surface-to-interior epistemic arc once 31:20's outward/inward pair and 31:16's nested mustard seed activated خَبِير.
Repeated return-report-work sequences changed the closing knowledge clause into a process of carried work reaching disclosure.
The ship-wave-shore sequence changed abstract celestial running into a contained navigational model of passage through alternating media.
31:34 changed the appointed cosmic term into evidence for a personal horizon that is certain yet undisclosed to the self.
summary.what_was_special: The focus ayah supports several mechanisms at once: reciprocal temporal ingress, governed finite courses, hydraulic circulation, visibility opening onto interior knowledge, and form-distant social or spatial images. Context did not collapse them; it separately activated ecological, gestational, accountability, scale, navigation, and epistemic readings.
remaining_uncertainties: The hydraulic and navigational models are coherent across several branches but remain material analogies rather than replacements for the ordinary temporal syntax.
The gestational transition depends on a reader-supplied process analogy between 31:14 and reciprocal day/night ingress.
The س م م and و س م activations behind مُسَمًّى are deliberately preserved split-root outliers and should not be lexicalized without qualification.
The personal extension of كُلٌّ from luminaries to selves is contextually strong but not the immediate grammatical referent in 31:29.

reader_a.activated_readings_md:
1. **Time is produced by reciprocal entry, not sealed blocks.** **و ل ج B001/B004** is entering an interior and repeated going in and out; **ل ي ل B001** night-darkness; **ن ه ر B002–B003** day opening with light and widening. The reversed repetition makes each period penetrate the other. I infer that temporal change occurs through graded exchange at boundaries. Night and day read as dynamically interleaved processes rather than alternating containers.
2. **Cosmic freedom is a governed habitual course.** **س خ ر B001** is being brought under command for a purpose; **ش م س B001** and **ق م ر B001** are sun/daylight and moon/light; **ج ر ي B001–B002** flow and habitual course; **ء ج ل B001** fixed limit. Motion remains real, but “each” runs inside a bounded assignment. I infer command → stable course rather than command → immobility. Subjection here is reliable patterned agency.
3. **Naming a limit raises it into an accountable designation.** *Musammā* activates **س م و B005**, “name as raised designation,” alongside **ء ج ل B001** appointed limit. The course does not simply cease; its endpoint is designated. I infer that naming makes the boundary fixed within an ordering knowledge. This sharpens the temporal claim from finite duration to assigned term.
4. **Tested interior knowledge joins cosmic courses to human work.** **ع م ل B001** is intentional work; **خ ب ر B001** tested inner knowledge. The final coordination moves from celestial motion to human acts without changing divine subject. I infer an analogy of governed trajectories: deeds also run toward assigned exposure, though the ayah explicitly supplies only knowledge. Human work is read under the same encompassing temporal order without being mechanized.
reader_a.retrospective_surprises_md: Ayah 31:31 repeated **ج ر ي B001** for the ship, translating cosmic course into vulnerable travel sustained by favor. Ayat 31:33–34 then made the appointed horizon existential: the promise is firm, but each self’s tomorrow and terminal ground remain unknown.

reader_a.activated_readings_md:
1. **Reciprocal temporal penetration inside named limits.** Lexical evidence: `و ل ج B001` is entering or inserting into an inside, `ل ي ل B001` is night and darkness, `ن ه ر B002` is day opening with light, `ج ر ي B001` is running in a course, `ء ج ل B001` is a fixed term, and `س م و B005` is naming as designation. Structural cue: night/day insertion is repeated in reverse order, then sun and moon are gathered by `كُلٌّ` under movement toward a named endpoint. Assigned role: insertion explains gradual transition, course explains regular motion, and designation fixes the boundary. Abductive move (inferred): cyclical interchange is continuous without being limitless because each course remains assigned an endpoint. Reading change: time reads as regulated interpenetration, not alternating blocks or uncontrolled recurrence.

2. **Cosmic regularity joined to the audit of work.** Lexical evidence: `س خ ر B001` is making a thing serviceable under command, `ع م ل B001` is intentional action, and `خ ب ر B001` is tested inner knowledge. Structural cue: the second `وَأَنَّ` coordinates knowledge of human work with the preceding cosmic operations. Assigned role: celestial subjection displays macro-level command; expert knowledge tracks micro-level intentional production. Abductive move (inferred): the same ordering competence that maintains visible cycles can preserve the causal record of human acts. Reading change: cosmic observation becomes ethical evidence rather than a self-contained astronomical sign.

3. **A named term that remains humanly undisclosed.** Lexical evidence: `ء ج ل B001` is an appointed limit and `س م و B005` is a fixed designation. Structural cue: the endpoint is named but not dated; 31:34 will deny each self knowledge of tomorrow, death-place, and the Hour. Assigned role: designation establishes certainty of assignment without transferring schedule-control to the observer. Abductive move (inferred): being fixed in the ordering system does not entail being accessible to human prediction. Reading change: `أَجَلٍ مُّسَمًّى` combines determinacy with epistemic humility.
reader_a.retrospective_surprises_md: - 31:34 was the controlling later surprise: it named the Hour, tomorrow's gain, and death-place as unknown to the self. It therefore sharpened `مُّسَمًّى` into an assigned but undisclosed term and prevented observed cosmic regularity from being mistaken for ownership of the schedule.

baseline.text: Allah'ın geceyi gündüzün içine kattığını, gündüzü de gecenin içine kattığını; güneşi ve ayı buyruğu altına verdiğini görmedin mi? Her biri belirlenmiş bir süreye kadar akıp gider. Allah yaptıklarınızdan haberdardır.

findings.text: Gece ile gündüz kapalı bloklar halinde sırayla gelmez; birbirlerinin içine girerek sınırlarında dereceli bir zaman değişimi üretir.
Güneş ve ayın buyruk altında olması hareketsizlik değil, her birinin belirli sınıra dek güvenilir ve alışılmış bir çizgide akmasıdır.
Sürenin adlandırılmış olması sınırın kesin biçimde atanmış olduğunu gösterir, fakat insanın bu takvime eriştiği anlamına gelmez.
İnsan işlerinin iç yüzüyle bilinmesi, görünen göksel düzen ile amaçlı davranışların zaman içindeki hesabını aynı kuşatıcı düzene bağlar.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi, görmeyi hem gözle algılama hem de gözün işlevine benzetilen içsel kavrayış olarak kuruyor. Doğrudan göz tanıklığı bu çekirdeğin duyusal gerçekleşimidir; zihinsel görüş, uyku düşü ve başkalarına görünme amacı bu dalın dışında kalır.

lexicalization_scope.note: Yalın görme çekirdeği ile doğrudan göz tanıklığını ve görmeye çalışma bildiren bağlı kullanımlar birbirine karıştırılmaz.

concept_map.definition: Bir şeyi gözle ya da göz işlevi gören içsel kavrayışla algılamaktır. Gözün eriştiği yerde doğrudan görme, bu anlamın duyusal ve tanıklığa dayalı gerçekleşimidir.

facets.statement: Görülebilir bir şeyi gözle veya benzer bir içsel kavrayışla algılama.
